gaps.sentence: She was appointed ___ managing director at just thirty-four.
gaps.explanation: After 'appoint/elect/name + unique role' no article is used.

gaps.sentence: We stayed at ___ hotel right next to the station.
gaps.explanation: 'The station' — in a town there is usually one known station; context makes it definite.

gaps.sentence: Mount Everest is ___ highest mountain in the world.
The tour included ___ visit to the British Museum.
gaps.explanation: 'A visit' (one of many possible) and 'the British Museum' (museums take 'the').

gaps.sentence: We go to ___ cinema about once a month.
gaps.explanation: 'Go to the cinema/theatre' is a fixed phrase with 'the'.

gaps.sentence: ___ Netherlands borders both Belgium and Germany.
He was ___ only person to solve the puzzle.
gaps.explanation: 'The only person' — 'only' makes the noun unique, so 'the'.

gaps.sentence: They organized ___ charity concert for flood victims.
gaps.explanation: 'A charity concert' — one of many possible concerts, first mention.
